edgar_concentrations.excerpt: accounted for 10% or more of total revenue. The Company manages the business activities on a consolidated basis and operates in one reportable segment. The Company’s Chief Executive Officer is the Chief Operating Decision Maker (“CODM”). The CODM utilizes the Company’s long-range plan, which includes product development roadmaps and long-range financial models, as a key input to resource allocation. The CODM makes decisions on resource allocation, assesses performance of the business, and monitors budget versus actual results using income from operations. Net income is also a measure that is considered in monitoring budget versus actual results. Significant expenses within income from operations, as well as within net income, include cost of revenue, research and development, and selling, general, and administrative expenses, which are each separately presented on the Company’s Condensed Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income. Other segment items within net income include interest and other income, net, and income tax expense. The Company’s long-lived assets consist primarily of property, plant, and equipment, net. As of both September 30, 2026, and December 31, 2025, 80 % of long-lived assets were in the U.S. As of September 30, 2026, and December 31, 2025, no individual country other than the U.S. accounted for 10% or more of these assets. 25 ITEM 2. 6 | Hugo 美國一般外科／婦科清可；Ottava de novo 決定 | 產業事件 | Hugo ~2026H2-2027；Ottava ~2026H2。判讀：清可本身不改裁決；清可 ＋ 美國 12 個月累積 > 250 台才觸發 §3.F
7 | 本輪數據限制之補採集（不改裁決，但影響下次的分析品質） | 其他 | 下次複審時必補：① FY2023/24 之 AR／存貨／AP（補多年 CCC 趨勢）；② 近 12 個月內部人交易；③ 高管薪酬結構與 ROIC/TSR 掛鉤；④ 同業（SYK/EW/MDT）三表重採；⑤ ISRG 2015-2020 之逐年還原股價 ＋ 非 GAAP EPS（把 §11.7 的 pattern match 分解自「近似」升級為「精確」）

這份報告的保質期：2026-10-31（＝ Q3 2026 財報與 EUP 量化揭露前有效）。理由：本報告的唯一約束是估值，而估值的分母（FY27 EPS）在該日會被一個公司已承諾提供、且本報告無法預知的數字重新定義。在那之前，rearm（PEG ≤ 2.0 ＝ $348）持續有效且無條件。
最可能發生的 upside 因素：EUP 量化揭露為優於 −5pt，或管理層同步上調手術量指引作為對沖——這會一次解除本報告的分母爭議與最大的 Bear 腿。次高機率：Q2 beat 後的共識上修——FY26 共識若自 $10.42 上修至 ≥$10.75（+3.2%），rearm 在今天的價格就成立（本報告不預先入帳，但已把此路徑寫進 §14a 與機器欄）。
最可能發生的 downside 因素：賣方目標價下修潮伴隨共識 EPS 同步下修（觸發 #5）——現價已低於所有已知目標，重定價尚未走完；若 EPS 跟著下修，PEG 的分母縮小 → $348 這個 rearm 價位本身會往下移動，而我會發現自己在追一個正在後退的門檻。這是本報告最需要警覺的動態，也是「rearm 是 PEG ≤ 2.0 這個不等式、而不是 $348 這個數字」的實質理由。
